list.name: rule
list.label: Rule
list.query: SELECT DISTINCT rule FROM data_quality_event ORDER BY 1

options.content:
### Data Quality — OEE invariant violations (F3 · packiot_shadow · `public.data_quality_event`)
The oeecloud-worker DQ substrate (ADR-0037) side-writes one `data_quality_event` per computed grain row that breaks a physical invariant — **it never clamps or alters a served value**, it makes the silent corruption visible. `OEE_GT_1` = efficiency > 100% (the oee=8142 outliers). `NET_GT_GROSS` = quality > 1. `NEGATIVE_METRIC` = a count/duration below zero. This board is also the read-source for the P11 andon alerts.

panels.title: Total violations
panels.description: count(*) over data_quality_event for the selected rules/severities in-window.

targets.rawSql: SELECT count(*) AS value FROM data_quality_event WHERE rule IN ($rule) AND severity IN ($severity) AND $__timeFilter(detected_at)

panels.title: Errors (severity=error)
panels.description: Physically-impossible served values — oee>1, net>gross, negative metric.

targets.rawSql: SELECT count(*) AS value FROM data_quality_event WHERE severity = 'error' AND rule IN ($rule) AND $__timeFilter(detected_at)

panels.title: Worst OEE observed
panels.description: max(observed_value) for rule OEE_GT_1 — the magnitude of the impossible efficiency claim (the 8142 / 8.2e18 outliers).

targets.rawSql: SELECT max(observed_value) AS value FROM data_quality_event WHERE rule = 'OEE_GT_1' AND $__timeFilter(detected_at)

panels.title: Distinct equipment affected
panels.description: count(DISTINCT id_equipment) carrying at least one violation in-window.

targets.rawSql: SELECT count(DISTINCT id_equipment) AS value FROM data_quality_event WHERE rule IN ($rule) AND severity IN ($severity) AND $__timeFilter(detected_at)

panels.title: New violations over time (by rule)
panels.description: count of detections per time bucket, split by rule. Uses detected_at — a burst = a scan that just surfaced standing corruption.

targets.rawSql: SELECT $__timeGroupAlias(detected_at, '$__interval'), rule AS metric, count(*) AS value FROM data_quality_event WHERE rule IN ($rule) AND severity IN ($severity) AND $__timeFilter(detected_at) GROUP BY 1, rule ORDER BY 1

panels.title: Top offending rules
panels.description: count(*) grouped by rule — which invariant is broken most.

targets.rawSql: SELECT rule, count(*) AS violations FROM data_quality_event WHERE rule IN ($rule) AND severity IN ($severity) AND $__timeFilter(detected_at) GROUP BY rule ORDER BY violations DESC

panels.title: Violations by rule × enterprise × equipment
panels.description: The full offender breakdown — one row per (rule, id_enterprise, id_equipment, grain) with count and the worst observed_value. This is the drill-down that surfaces the 641.

targets.rawSql: SELECT rule, id_enterprise, id_equipment, grain, severity, count(*) AS violations, max(observed_value) AS worst_observed, max(detected_at) AS last_detected FROM data_quality_event WHERE rule IN ($rule) AND severity IN ($severity) AND $__timeFilter(detected_at) GROUP BY rule, id_enterprise, id_equipment, grain, severity ORDER BY violations DESC, worst_observed DESC NULLS LAST LIMIT 500

panels.title: Worst observed value per rule
panels.description: The single most extreme observed_value per rule — the magnitude of the worst corruption of each kind.

targets.rawSql: SELECT rule, severity, count(*) AS violations, max(observed_value) AS worst_observed, min(observed_value) AS min_observed FROM data_quality_event WHERE rule IN ($rule) AND severity IN ($severity) AND $__timeFilter(detected_at) GROUP BY rule, severity ORDER BY worst_observed DESC NULLS LAST

panels.title: Open counts by severity × grain
panels.description: Where the violations concentrate across aggregation grains (shift/hour/day/week/month) and severities.

targets.rawSql: SELECT severity, grain, rule, count(*) AS violations FROM data_quality_event WHERE rule IN ($rule) AND severity IN ($severity) AND $__timeFilter(detected_at) GROUP BY severity, grain, rule ORDER BY violations DESC
